text:
My neighbor decided to take security seriously, putting up a bold "Beware of Dog" sign. Naturally, this was a bold claim for my three-pound furball, a creature whose primary defense mechanism is to vibrate with anxiety. When the postman arrived, my tiny dog charged out, presumably to defend the realm, and the postman deadpanned, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That comment broke my dog. He took it as a personal challenge to prove the postman wrong. Now, he’s on a relentless mission to intimidate the mail carrier, though his strategy mostly involves barking at his own tail and then looking confused when he can’t catch it. It’s less "guard dog" and more "confused plush toy with a heartbeat."

As for the eggplant, it is purple.
